text:
alex: CI alert on the PCI-integration KB — link-scan flagged an external vendor doc as 404: https://vendor.example.com/api-auth. Can someone grab a quick fix? :wave:

rachel: thanks — which page is that on?

alex: /kb/pci-integration/index.md. CI shows 1 failed external link. I can open a tiny PR to swap to an archived copy or internal mirror.

pri: pinging @matt for infra/hosting ok. Prefer internal shortlink if we can host the mirror. avoids repeated rot.

matt: hosting is fine. If you mirror, put it under /kb/assets/vendor-api-auth-archive.html and add a redirect. Also update frontmatter last_updated.

alex: plan: I'll create an asset, replace the URL and add a one-line note about why we used an archive. sed snippet I used locally:
```
git checkout -b docs/fix/pci-vendor-link
sed -i 's|https://vendor.example.com/api-auth|/kb/assets/vendor-api-auth-archive.html|g' kb/pci-integration/index.md
mkdir -p kb/assets && cp /tmp/vendor-api-auth-archive.html kb/assets/
git add kb/assets/vendor-api-auth-archive.html kb/pci-integration/index.md && git commit -m "docs: replace dead vendor link with archived asset"
```
(Will push and open PR in a minute.)

rachel: assign to me for CR. I'll double-check the wording about archival and merge once CI/link-scan clears. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: link-scan will re-run automatically after merge and report status in the PR.

alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/p/docs/1234 — added note that legal ok'd archival. @rachel pls review.

pri: tiny suggestion — add a parenthetical like "(archived copy retained for continuity)" next to the link so future readers understand why it isn't the vendor canonical.

rachel: good call, I'll add that in the PR comment and then LGTM after CI pass.

matt: thanks all. if the scan finds other vendor links in that namespace, we should consider a short-run sweep. ping me and I can allocate a small host path for any more archives.

alex: will run quick grep for vendor.example.com and send follow-up if >1. closing loop here once PR merged.
